in_sanskrit.name: बांदरी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who carries a banner or a flag, a standard bearer.

in_hindi.name: बांदरी
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who carries a weapon (बाण), or a flag (ध्वज), or a standard (ध्वजदारी).

in_tamil.name: பாண்டரி
in_tamil.meaning: பாண்டுகள் அடிக்கோப்புரில் இருந்து, உடல்கால் அடிக்கோப்புரில் இருந்து
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who lives near a banner (பாண்டுகள்), or one who is in the water (உடல்கால்) and holds a banner (அடிக்கோப்பு).

in_telugu.name: బాణ్డరి
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who carries a weapon (బాణ్యేదు), or one who carries a flag (ధ్వజీయేదు).

in_marathi.name: Bandari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bearer of good news
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bandari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bandari is a Sanskrit name, derived from the word ‘bandhu’ meaning friend. The name Bandari is given to a girl who is believed to carry good news and spread happiness. In Hindu mythology, Bandari is also the name of a celestial nymph or apsara who is known for her beautiful voice and the ability to bring joy to people.
